fields.title: 📖 Zayd ibn ʿAmr: None of you is upon the religion of Ibrāhīm
fields.body:
🖋️ **Asmāʾ bint Abī Bakr** reported that Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl stood with his back to the Kaʿbah and said:

***“O people of Quraysh! By Allah, none of you is upon the religion of Ibrāhīm except me.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement is a strong example of **Takfīr bil-ʿUmūm**: Zayd judges the general religious state of the Quraysh, because they had left the religion of Ibrāhīm. This is a general judgment upon the state of Shirk, not automatically an individual judgment, with all its conditions, upon every specific person.

immutable.source: 📝 Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb Manāqib al-Anṣār, Bāb Ḥadīth Zayd ibn ʿAmr ibn Nufayl, Ḥadīth Nr. 3828.
